propositions: Residual live uses of deprecated Success Criteria vocabulary in src/rebar/llm/completion.py and tests/interfaces/store/test_completion_verifier.py must be migrated to Acceptance Criteria wording
A count-pinned allowlist at scripts/criteria-vocabulary-allowlist.txt must enumerate all deliberate phrase and bare-token matches with non-vacuous counts, preventing silent reintroduction
The new guard scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py must fail deterministically on unallowlisted matches, count drift, malformed entries, duplicate paths, and stale entries
The root Makefile lint target must wire the guard so local make lint and CI run the same vocabulary check

Scoped bare-token scanning for SC/SCs must apply only to src/rebar/llm/reviewers/, src/rebar/_guides/, .rebar/criteria_routing.json, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_routing.json, and generated docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md

Four permanent semantic carve-outs owned by the epic (T2 experiment language, definition-of-done probes, Jira captures, and historical citations) must remain represented by non-vacuous allowlist rows at their documented counts
